item.title: Version 0.1.15
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.15 — three quality fixes for new BYO users.
• Onboarding now suggests a weekly target even when you connect through your own personal Strava API client. Previously the suggestion only worked if the first sync had completed before you advanced to the goal step — BYO users routinely beat the sync and got stranded with the 40 km fallback. The seed now reacts to the first batch of activities landing in the store. • Settings → Strava gains a Reconnect button when the connection enters an error state. No more disconnect-then-reconfigure dance just to refresh a stale OAuth token. • Webhook receiver now honours Strava aspect_type=delete events and removes the matching activity from the local store immediately, instead of waiting for the next 7-day cache sweep. This closes the Strava API Agreement § 2.6f gap (48h delete SLA).
